items.source:
"Static" attributes are fixed attributes that are specified in
the View instance configuration. "Dynamic" attributes, on the other hand,
are values passed in as part of the model.
items.translation: “静态”属性是指在视图实例配置中指定的固定属性。另一方面，“动态”属性是作为模型的一部分传入的值。

items.source: request - current HTTP request
items.translation: request - 当前 HTTP 请求

items.source: Set the content type of the response to the configured content type unless the View.SELECTED_CONTENT_TYPE request attribute is present and set to a concrete media type.
items.translation: 将响应内容类型设置为配置的content type，除非存在并设置为具体媒体类型的View.SELECTED_CONTENT_TYPE请求属性。

items.source: response - current HTTP response
items.translation: response - 当前 HTTP 响应

items.source: Extends WebApplicationObjectSupport, which will be helpful to some views. Subclasses just need to implement the actual rendering.
items.translation: 继承自 `WebApplicationObjectSupport`，这对某些视图很有帮助。子类只需实现实际的渲染逻辑即可。

items.source: Path variables added to the model override static attributes (see setAttributes(Properties)) but not attributes already present in the model.
items.translation: 模型中新增的路径变量会覆盖静态属性（参见setAttributes(Properties)），但不会覆盖模型中已存在的属性。

items.source: This will make all such beans accessible in plain ${...} expressions in a JSP 2.0 page, as well as in JSTL's c:out value expressions.
items.translation: 这将使所有此类 bean 在 JSP 2.0 页面的普通 `${...}` 表达式以及 JSTL 的 `c:out` 值表达式中均可访问。

items.source: If you'd like to expose all Spring beans in the application context, switch the "exposeContextBeansAsAttributes" flag on but do not list specific bean names for this property.
items.translation: 如果您希望暴露应用程序上下文中的所有 Spring Bean，请开启"exposeContextBeansAsAttributes"标志，但不要为该属性列出特定的 Bean 名称。

items.source: The default implementation returns false. Subclasses are encouraged to return true here if they know that they are generating download content that requires temporary caching on the client side, typically via the response OutputStream.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `false`。如果子类知道它们正在生成需要在客户端进行临时缓存的下载内容（通常通过响应 `OutputStream` 实现），则鼓励在此处返回 `true`。

items.source: Useful for specifying entries directly, for example via attributesMap[myKey]. This is particularly useful for adding or overriding entries in child view definitions.
items.translation: 适用于直接指定条目，例如通过`attributesMap[myKey]`。这对于在子视图定义中添加或覆盖条目特别有用。

items.source: Must be invoked before any calls to render.
items.translation: 必须在调用任何render之前进行调用。

items.source: Path variables are commonly bound to URI template variables through the @PathVariable annotation. They are effectively URI template variables with type conversion applied to them to derive typed Object values. Such values are frequently needed in views for constructing links to the same and other URLs.
items.translation: 路径变量通常通过 `@PathVariable` 注解绑定到 URI 模板变量。它们本质上是带有类型转换的 URI 模板变量，用于派生具有类型的对象值。此类值在视图中经常需要，以便构建指向当前及其他 URL 的链接。

items.source: By default this flag is set to true. Concrete view types can override this.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此标志设置为true。具体视图类型可以覆盖此设置。

items.source: NOTE: Context beans will override any custom request or session attributes of the same name that have been manually added. However, model attributes (as explicitly exposed to this view) of the same name will always override context beans.
items.translation: 注意： 上下文 Bean 将覆盖任何已手动添加的同名自定义请求或会话属性。然而，同名模型属性（如明确暴露给此视图的）将始终覆盖上下文 Bean。

items.source:
Provides support for static attributes, to be made available to the view,
with a variety of ways to specify them. Static attributes will be merged
with the given dynamic attributes (the model that the controller returned)
for each render operation.
items.translation: 提供对静态属性的支持，以便以多种方式将其提供给视图。在每次渲染操作中，静态属性将与给定的动态属性（控制器返回的模型）进行合并。

items.source:
May be ignored by subclasses if the view itself is assumed
to set the content type, for example, in case of JSPs.
items.translation: 如果视图本身被假定会设置内容类型（例如在 JSP 的情况下），则子类可能会忽略此设置。

items.source:
This is the most convenient way to set static attributes. Note that
static attributes can be overridden by dynamic attributes, if a value
with the same name is included in the model.
items.translation: 这是设置静态属性最方便的方法。请注意，如果模型中包含同名值，静态属性可能会被动态属性覆盖。

items.source:
Returns an unmodifiable Map, as this is not intended for
manipulating the Map but rather just for checking the contents.
items.translation: 返回一个不可修改的 Map，因为此方法并非用于操作 Map，而仅用于检查其内容。

items.source:
Default is "false". Switch this flag on to transparently expose all
Spring beans in the request attribute namespace.
items.translation: 默认值为"false"。打开此标志，可在请求属性命名空间中透明地暴露所有 Spring  bean。

items.source:
The default implementation creates a standard RequestContext instance for the
given request and model. Can be overridden in subclasses for custom instances.
items.translation: 默认实现会为给定的请求和模型创建标准的 RequestContext 实例。可在子类中重写以使用自定义实例。

items.source:
The default implementation wraps the original request for exposure of Spring beans
as request attributes (if demanded).
items.translation: 默认实现会包装原始请求，以暴露 Spring  bean（如果要求的话）作为请求属性。

items.source:
This is typically used as IE workaround, for setting the content length header
from the temporary stream before actually writing the content to the HTTP response.
items.translation: 这通常用作 Internet Explorer 的变通方法，用于在将内容实际写入 HTTP 响应之前，从临时流中设置 Content-Length 标头。

items.source: Get the request handle to expose to renderMergedOutputModel(Map, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse), i.e.

items.source: Return the view's name. Should never be null, if the view was correctly configured.
items.translation: 返回视图的名称。如果视图配置正确，该值绝不应该是 `null`。

items.source: Creates a combined output Map (never null) that includes dynamic values and static attributes. Dynamic values take precedence over static attributes.
items.translation: 创建一个组合输出 Map（永远不为 `null`），其中包含动态值和静态属性。动态值优先于静态属性。

items.source: Expose the model objects in the given map as request attributes. Names will be taken from the model Map. This method is suitable for all resources reachable by RequestDispatcher.
items.translation: 将给定映射中的模型对象作为请求属性暴露。名称取自模型 Map。此方法适用于所有可通过 `RequestDispatcher` 访问的资源。

items.source: Return the content type for this view.
items.translation: 返回此视图的内容类型。

items.source: Return the name of the RequestContext attribute, if any.
items.translation: 返回 RequestContext 属性的名称（如果有）。

items.source: Return whether to add path variables to the model or not.
items.translation: 返回是否将路径变量添加到模型中。

items.source: Write the given temporary OutputStream to the HTTP response.
items.translation: 将给定的临时 OutputStream 写入 HTTP 响应。

items.source: Default content type. Overridable as bean property.
items.translation: 默认内容类型。可作为 Bean 属性进行覆盖。

items.source:
Set the name of the RequestContext attribute for this view.
Default is none.
items.translation: 设置此视图的 RequestContext 属性名称。默认值为无。

items.source:
Prepares the view given the specified model, merging it with static
attributes and a RequestContext attribute, if necessary.
Delegates to renderMergedOutputModel for the actual rendering.
items.translation: 根据指定的模型准备视图，如有必要则将其与静态属性和 RequestContext 属性合并。实际渲染由 renderMergedOutputModel 委托处理。

Can be populated with a String "value" (parsed via PropertiesEditor)
or a "props" element in XML bean definitions.
items.translation: 可以填充为通过 PropertiesEditor 解析的 String“值”，或者在 XML Bean 定义中的“props”元素。

items.translation: 可以使用 XML 中的“map”或“props”元素进行填充。

The default implementation applies a workaround for an IE bug
when sending download content via HTTPS.
items.translation: 默认实现针对通过 HTTPS 发送下载内容时出现的 IE 浏览器错误应用了一个变通方案。

items.source:
The first step will be preparing the request: In the JSP case,
this would mean setting model objects as request attributes.
The second step will be the actual rendering of the view,
for example including the JSP via a RequestDispatcher.
items.translation: 第一步是准备请求：在 JSP 的情况下，这意味着将模型对象设置为请求属性。第二步是视图的实际渲染，例如通过 RequestDispatcher 包含 JSP。

items.source: Creates a combined output Map (never null) that includes dynamic values and static attributes.
items.translation: 创建一个组合输出 Map（永远不为null），其中包含动态值和静态属性。

items.source: Allow Map access to the static attributes of this view, with the option to add or override specific entries.
items.translation: 允许通过 `Map` 访问此视图的静态属性，并可选择添加或覆盖特定条目。

items.translation: 返回此视图是否生成下载内容（通常是二进制内容，如 PDF 或 Excel 文件）。

Set whether to make all Spring beans in the application context accessible

items.translation: 设置是否通过懒加载检查（仅在访问属性时进行）使应用程序上下文中的所有 Spring bean 可用作请求属性。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean in the factory. Note that this name is the actual bean name used in the factory, which may differ from the originally specified name: in particular for inner bean names, the actual bean name might have been made unique through appending "#..." suffixes. Use the BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String) method to extract the original bean name (without suffix), if desired.
items.translation: beanName - 工厂中 Bean 的名称。请注意，此名称是工厂中实际使用的 Bean 名称，可能与最初指定的名称不同：特别是对于内部 Bean 名称，实际 Bean 名称可能已通过追加"#..."后缀使其唯一化。如需提取原始 Bean 名称（不带后缀），请使用BeanFactoryUtils.originalBeanName(String)方法。
